day_shape: 64 items: France names IRGC for October refrigerator cyberattacks and summons Tehran's ambassador, Qatari PM meets Trump on Iran mediation, two OFAC sanctions notices published, and heavy regime messaging on US midterms and alleged 'seven conditions' for Washington.

threads.label: France attributes cyberattack to IRGC
threads.summary: France on Monday accused Iran's Revolutionary Guards of carrying out October cyberattacks that disrupted commercial refrigeration at hundreds of French businesses, summoned Tehran's ambassador, and announced plans for EU sanctions. Israeli police and Shin Bet separately said they were investigating Iran-linked flyers with QR codes placed in Tel Aviv mailboxes.

threads.label: Qatar-led mediation and US-Iran talks
threads.summary: Qatar's prime minister held a 45-minute meeting with Trump in Washington on Iran mediation, with Turkey saying high-level US-Iran talks are planned in Doha. Trump told Reuters Qatar and Saudi Arabia want a peaceful solution but the US is ready to resume strikes; Rubio called some Iranian conditions "outrageous and ridiculous."

threads.label: Tehran posture on negotiations
threads.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaii said export of enriched materials is not on the agenda and that Tehran has shortened its proposed plan's implementation window from seven to two days. Regime channels carried Commander Rezaei demanding the US "surrender to Iran's seven conditions" and Speaker Qalibaf claiming Israel is trying to drag Washington into an endless war.

threads.label: US midterms read from Tehran
threads.summary: Iran International reported debate among Tehran analysts and reformist intellectuals over whether Trump's midterm defeat opens space for diplomacy or risks escalation. Regime channels amplified a Democratic House leader pledging to "stop Iran's war" and MP Qazi-Zadeh Hashemi calling Republicans "confused after a historic defeat."

threads.label: Gaza winter supplies and Board of Peace
threads.summary: The IDF and COGAT said over 91,000 tents and 8,200+ trucks of winter supplies have entered Gaza, after Trump's Board of Peace urged Israel to admit winter aid, calling flooding an immediate humanitarian emergency. Hamas held Israel responsible for the humanitarian crisis, per IRIB.

threads.label: Yemen-Saudi exchanges
threads.summary: Yemeni armed forces spokesman Yahya Saree said they downed a Saudi CH-4 reconnaissance drone over Al-Jawf and reported 103 Saudi airstrikes in 24 hours across Marib, Saada, Taiz, Lahj, Al-Jawf and Al-Hudaidah. A Yemeni military source via Saba advised personnel near designated Saudi targets to evacuate; the Jerusalem Post reported analyst questions about Syrian forces' presence in Saudi Arabia.

threads.label: Iran domestic enforcement and appointments
threads.summary: Iran International reported Tehran prosecutors opening a case against a gynecologist who discussed single motherhood, the Football Federation suspending a board member who stayed seated during the anthem, and allegations a 17-year-old killed in January was tortured at age 13. It also reported IRGC Quds Force commander Abdolreza Masgarian has been selected as Iran's next ambassador to Iraq.

events.title_en: Order from Yemen's armed forces to evacuate Saudi Arabia. A Yemeni military source told the official Saba news agency:
events.summary_en: Order from Yemen's armed forces to evacuate Saudi Arabia. A Yemeni military source told the official Saba news agency: We advise employees and individuals near facilities and centres that Yemen's armed forces have designated as targets of their attacks to move away from these places and facilities so their lives are not endangered. Companies from countries not participating in the war against Yemen should inform relevant authorities in Sana'a of their investment locations in Saudi Arabia so they are spared from attacks. Companies that have declared their intention to leave and halt their investments in Saudi Arabia to competent authorities in Sana'a will be facilitated in the withdrawal of their assets and all necessary assistance will be provided.

events.summary_en: Baghaii: Export of enriched materials from Iran is in no way on the agenda. Spokesman for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran, explaining the latest developments related to talks between Tehran and Washington, announced a reduction in the implementation period of Iran's proposed plan from seven days to two days and described this step as an indication of the seriousness and good faith of the Islamic Republic of Iran in the path of diplomacy. There is clear confusion within the US government about which institution or official bears responsibility and authority for negotiations with Iran, and some US officials are putting forward contradictory positions and demands. Export of enriched materials from Iran is in no way on the agenda and there is fundamentally no reason for such action.

events.title_en: Yahya Saree: Saudi fighter jets carried out 103 bombing raids on Yemen.
events.summary_en: Yahya Saree: Saudi fighter jets carried out 103 bombing raids on Yemen. Yahya Saree, spokesman for Yemen's armed forces, announced that the Saudi enemy carried out 103 airstrikes against Yemen over the past 24 hours. Saudi fighter jets bombed civilian areas in Marib, Saada, Taiz, Lahj, Al-Jawf and Al-Hudaidah provinces. The strikes were carried out with F-15 and Typhoon fighter jets that took off from the Khamis Mushayt and Taif bases. As a result of these attacks, a number of civilians were killed and wounded. The total number of Saudi Arabia's air and missile attacks against Yemen since the escalation of tensions began has reached 4563 air and missile strikes.

events.summary_en: Meeting of members of the office for the preservation and publication of the works of the martyred leader of the revolution with the family of General Mahmoud Bagheri. In continuation of the First Family of Martyrs campaign, members of the office for the preservation and publication of the works of the martyred leader of the Islamic Revolution, along with General Commander Amir Jafari and a number of media and community members, visited the home of General Shahid Mahmoud Bagheri, commander of the missile forces of the IRGC Aerospace Force, and whilst paying tribute to this esteemed martyr, met and spoke with his honourable family. General Jafari said in this meeting: Shahid Bagheri, along with Commander Mousavi and Shahid Hajizadeh, formed a powerful team for enhancing the country's missile capabilities and continue to do so. The focus of the IRGC Aerospace Force from the beginning.

events.title: 88 years ago today, on what would become known as Kristallnacht, the Nazis set fire to over 1,400 synagogues, looted and destroyed thousands of Jewish owned businesses and homes. That night, they attacked and murdered Jewish people across Germany. Almost 26,000 Jewish men were arrested and sent to concentration camps. The world watched in silence as Jewish lives were shattered and their humanity was denied. No army came to protect them. Today, the Jewish people aren’t defenseless anymore. The IDF is there to protect Israel and its people, determined to eliminate any threat.
